correctness.rationale: For even \(N\) and even \(j\), the term magnitude reduces exactly to a rational Bernoulli expression. The cited primary theorem proves that \(j=8\) is the unique largest term for both Fibonacci and Lucas weights for every even \(N\ge26\). Exact exhaustive comparison over all admissible even indices for \(N=14,16,18,20,22,24\) gives \(j=8\) uniquely in every case, while \(N=12\) has unique winner \(j=10\) for both sequences. A fresh independent exact-rational replay reproduced every winner, runner-up and positive gap printed in the package. Thus the finite certificate bridges the published infinite range without being used as an infinite proof, and \(N_0=14\) is the sharp smallest even threshold.
